reason: Owner decision 2026-10-01 (question 18, relayed by [MK] Integrator, recorded in AGENTS.md §10): MK2's spring-vfs content.mount and content.resolve-dependencies are superseded by the MK3 design. A subject of Beyond All Reason reaches its dependencies through the mod context of the BAR content source (openModContext and locateModPackage of local:beyond-all-reason, spring 49b4b0a), built over the installation's archives as one tree by createLayeredArchiveContentSources — the one way a subject reaches its dependencies in MK3, as for every other game. No operation mounts or resolves on a codec. MK3 is the reference, no MK2 comparison is run.

rows.label: Mount a Spring archive with the archives it depends on
